senses.gloss: --the ninth day in the latter half of the three (or four) months following the full moon in अग्रहायन, पौष, माघ, (फाल्गुन)। The fourth month is men- tioned in the पुराण. वा. ८१. 4, 5.
--the particular Agni from which वृत्र was born. भा. VI. 9. १२. [page१-071+ २६]
--a fire rite on the conjunction of the पर्वस्। Br. II. २८. ३७.

(अध्यात्मकी विद्या, s.v.)--Taught by Dat- तात्रेय to Alarka and others.
1: भा. I. 3. ११; M. २१५. ५४; Vi. V. १०. २७.
Produced by ब्रह्मा.
2: भा. III. १२. ४४; २५. 4.
Helps concentration on the Absolute.
3: Ib. XI. २०. २४.
Learnt by राम and कृष्ण.
4: Ib. X. ४५. ३४.
Symbolical of देवी.
5: Vi. I. 9. १२१.
[page१-161+ ३०]
